scope.focus: arbitrary positive shard lengths and ragged final vectors

algorithm: Retain the 32-byte YMM streaming loop for complete chunks.
Use one overlapping in-range 32-byte final vector for 16..31-byte remainders.
Use one overlapping in-range 16-byte final vector for 8..15-byte remainders after a complete YMM chunk.
Use one overlapping in-range 8-byte final vector for 4..7-byte remainders after a complete YMM chunk.
Use one overlapping in-range 4-byte final vector for 1..3-byte remainders after a complete YMM chunk.
For exact B=8..15 and B=16..31, use one full-width vector plus a second overlapping final vector when needed.
Retain the scalar oracle-quality path only for exact B=1..7.
implementation.bounds_proof: Every overlapping access has interval [B-W,B), with B>=W. The public selector has already proved disjoint input and output ranges; re-writing independent parity bytes in the overlap is idempotent.

authoritative_abba.performance_statistic: Geometric mean of one balanced log contrast per independent ABBA round with two-sided Student-t 95 percent confidence intervals.
authoritative_abba.correctness: All 312 invocations selected AVX2, retained clean source attestations, preserved frozen hashes, and matched original, parity, and recovery FNV-1a digests across implementations.

exhaustive_and_long_directional_map.exact_application_bytes: Leopard2 encoded the exact requested B bytes.
exhaustive_and_long_directional_map.main_padding_policy: Leopard main encoded ceil(B/64)*64 physical bytes with a zero suffix; timings therefore report both exact logical B and padded physical bytes.

coverage: Every exact B=1..65 across public encode, one-item batch, and reusable batch binding
Independent direct systematic generator and forced mature transform parity
Linux per-source and per-output PROT_NONE guard pages for every B=8..65
Unaligned packed slabs, canary guards, sparse outputs, detached inputs, and nonpacked fallbacks
Scratch, metadata, input/output alias, cross-item alias, and failure-atomicity controls
Representative remainder classes after longer prefixes through B=2048 plus B2049 and larger selector neighbors
correctness_gates.review_result: No skipped byte, OOB access, aliasing UB, compiler portability blocker, or acceptance gap found.

development_rejection.prototype: A first uncommitted 4-byte final window for a 5-byte remainder skipped one byte at B37.
development_rejection.detection: The newly exhaustive direct-generator test failed immediately.
development_rejection.resolution: Use a window at least as wide as the entire remainder class; the corrected source passed exhaustive, guard-page, sanitizer, and differential gates before commit.

resource_policy.reason: Prior OOMs required serialized capped compiler work. ASan execution was uncapped and single-threaded because its shadow mapping is incompatible with RLIMIT_AS. Cache-sensitive timings were pinned to one physical core and resumed only after all read-only workers finished.

disposition: Promoted. K4/R2 exact ragged encoding no longer falls behind padded Leopard main in any clean B1..65 or representative through-B2049 cell. The new in-range vector tails are 1.209x to 3.945x faster than the prior Leopard2 scalar tails at the qualified targets and retain deterministic legacy parity.
